The '''Rucksack of the Tusken King''' was a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] crafted from the [[Bone/Legends|skull]] of a young [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]]. The pack was owned by the [[Tusken King]], leader of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribe.<ref name="SWG" /> While ostensibly a display of power, it was fully functional as a backpack.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="SWGTCG" /> When the Tusken Raider tribe [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|attacked]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[King/Legends|King]] wore the pack into battle. When he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and his tribe defeated with the combined efforts of the townsfolk and a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], the rucksack was looted from his body.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rucksack of the Tusken King appeared as a wearable container (or backpack) in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively-multiplayer online role playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was added to the game on [[November 1]], [[2007]] with the introduction of the Tusken Army heroic instance. The chance of looting a Tusken King Rucksack schematic from the Tusken King's corpse was rare. Once looted, the schematic required a character of the Domestic Goods Trader profession to learn and craft the rucksack. The rucksack could hold slightly more items than a regular backpack, and it gave several significant increases to the player's combat statistics when worn.<ref name="SWG" /> It also appeared as an "Item" card in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' set ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' and was a reward for all players who completed the Tusken Army "Heroic encounter" that was released concurrently with the set.
